name: claude-code-usage

scripts.prices:refresh: node -e "fetch(process.env.APP_URL||'http://localhost:4747/api/prices',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'refresh'})}).then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>console.log(j.ok?`ok: ${j.found} Claude models, ${j.updated.length} price(s) changed, ${j.added.length} new`:`failed: ${j.error}`)).catch(e=>{console.error('is the app running?',e.message);process.exit(1)})"

description: Local dashboard for Claude Code token usage, cost and what actually burns the tokens.
